After-Sales Service: The seller shall provide necessary after-sales support and technical assistanc e throughout the warranty period. Any complaint regarding defects shall be attended to promptly wi thout any additional financial liability to the Buyer. 4. Genuine Product: The seller shall supply only brand-new, unused, genuine and original products. Refurbished, second-hand, repaired or duplicate products shall not be accepted. 5. Technical Compliance: The seller shall ensure compliance with all technical specifications and elig ibility conditions stipulated in the bid. Relevant supporting documents, wherever required, shall be u ploaded along with the bid. 6. Delivery: The product shall be delivered within the delivery period stipulated in the GeM Bid. Inspection and Acceptance: The supplied product shall be subject to inspection and verification by the Buyer. Payment shall be processed only after satisfactory verification and acceptance of the product. 8. Non-Compliance: Any deviation from the stipulated technical specifications, warranty conditions o r other ATC requirements may render the offer liable for rejection, subject to applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC) and procurement guidelines. 9. Acceptance of ATC: Submission of a bid shall imply acceptance of the above Additional Terms & C onditions by the seller. Imp Note : Original Purchase Invoice: The seller shall provide the original tax invoice/bill of the sam e product, clearly indicating its make, model and serial number, duly issued by the seller/authorised dealer, which shall be mandatory for claiming warranty services during the one-year warranty perio d. Note: All other terms and conditions shall be governed by the applicable GeM General Terms and Conditio ns (GTC) and prevailing Government procurement rules. .
